products.name: Aurora Wireless Headphones
products.description: Over-ear headphones with adaptive noise cancelling and 40 hours of playback. Memory-foam cushions and a folding frame make them easy to live with on long flights.

products.name: Pulse True Wireless Earbuds
products.description: Pocket-sized earbuds with a six-hour charge and a case that adds three more. IPX5 rated, with touch controls you can actually find.

products.name: Echo Portable Speaker
products.description: A fabric-wrapped speaker with a surprisingly deep low end for its size. Pair two for stereo, and take it to the beach without worrying about the splash.

products.name: Studio Desk Microphone
products.description: USB-C condenser microphone with a cardioid pattern and a hardware mute button. Zero-latency monitoring through the built-in headphone jack.

products.name: Stride Fitness Band
products.description: Slim band with continuous heart-rate, SpO2 and sleep staging. Two weeks of battery and an always-on display that stays readable in sunlight.

products.name: Horizon Smartwatch
products.description: A 1.4-inch AMOLED watch with built-in GPS, call handling and over 100 workout modes. The sapphire glass and steel case shrug off daily knocks.

products.name: Nimbus Sleep Ring
products.description: A titanium ring that tracks sleep, temperature and recovery without a screen to glance at. Seven days of battery, charges in under an hour.

products.name: Trail GPS Watch
products.description: Multi-band GPS with offline topographic maps and a 30-day battery in watch mode. Built for trail runs and multi-day hikes.

products.name: Ember Pour-Over Kettle
products.description: Gooseneck kettle with variable temperature control and a 60-minute hold. The counterbalanced handle gives a slow, even pour.

products.name: Terra Ceramic Mug Set
products.description: Four stoneware mugs with a speckled reactive glaze, so no two are quite alike. 350 ml, dishwasher and microwave safe.

products.name: Nordic Cast Iron Pan
products.description: A 26 cm pre-seasoned skillet with a smooth cooking surface and a helper handle. Goes from hob to oven to table.

products.name: Lumen Desk Lamp
products.description: An articulating LED lamp with five colour temperatures and stepless dimming. The base doubles as a wireless phone charger.

products.name: Commuter Laptop Backpack
products.description: A 20-litre backpack with a padded 16-inch laptop sleeve and a luggage pass-through. Recycled water-resistant shell, lifetime stitching warranty.

products.name: Weekender Duffel
products.description: Waxed canvas and full-grain leather trim in a 40-litre carry-on friendly size. A separate shoe compartment keeps the rest of your clothes clean.

products.name: Slim Card Wallet
products.description: Holds six cards and a few folded notes with RFID shielding built in. Vegetable-tanned leather that darkens with use.

products.name: Carry-On Hard Shell Suitcase
products.description: A polycarbonate carry-on with silent 360-degree wheels and a TSA-approved lock. Sized to fit every major airline's cabin limit.

products.name: Linen Hardcover Notebook
products.description: A5 dotted notebook with 192 pages of 100 gsm paper that takes fountain pen ink without bleeding. Lay-flat binding and a ribbon marker.

products.name: Brass Fountain Pen
products.description: A solid brass fountain pen with a medium steel nib and a satisfying heft. Takes standard international cartridges or the included converter.

products.name: Desk Organiser Set
products.description: Three oak trays and a pen cup that nest together or spread across a desk. Oiled finish, felt feet.

products.name: Weekly Planner 2026
products.description: A week-to-view planner with a habit tracker on every spread and monthly reflection pages. Undated goals section at the back.

products.name: Cork Yoga Mat
products.description: Natural cork over a rubber base: grippier the sweatier you get, and naturally antimicrobial. 4 mm thick, 183 x 61 cm.

products.name: Adjustable Dumbbell Pair
products.description: Two dumbbells that dial from 2.5 to 24 kg each in 2.5 kg steps, replacing a full rack. Compact cradles keep them tidy.

products.name: Resistance Band Set
products.description: Five latex bands from extra-light to extra-heavy with a door anchor and handles. Fits in the pocket of your gym bag.

products.name: Insulated Steel Bottle 1L
products.description: Double-wall stainless steel that keeps drinks cold for 24 hours or hot for 12. Powder-coated grip and a leak-proof flip lid.
